# Figure 6



## Setup


```{r libs, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(BPCells)
library(Seurat)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(dplyr)
library(enrichplot)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(here)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r global_params}
load_data = T #loading data
subset_data = F

rmd_filename = "figure6_early_adipogenic_trajectories"
i_am(file.path("figures", paste0(rmd_filename,".Rmd")))
```

```{r setup}
set.seed(8)
fig_dir = here("figures", rmd_filename)
if (!dir.exists(fig_dir)) dir.create(fig_dir, recursive = TRUE)
knitr::opts_chunk$set(fig.path = paste0(fig_dir, "/"),
                      dev = c("png","pdf"))
```


```{r themes}
theme_hp = theme_classic(base_size = 15) +
  theme(axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.25),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        #Add facet boxes
        panel.border=element_rect(colour="lightgrey", fill=NA),
        #Add black border to colourbar legends
        legend.ticks = element_line(colour="black", linewidth=0.25),
        legend.frame = element_rect(colour="black", linewidth = 0.25),
        legend.title = element_text(size=13,hjust=0.5))
theme_set(theme_hp)
pal = c("#1F78B4","#85C2EA","#B3B3B3", "#F18486", "#E31A1C")
spectral = rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 11, name = 'Spectral'))
```
